title: The chip's failover line says the stored reason (usage limit, signed out, unavailable); a Claude request with no ceiling asks for 32000 output tokens
steps: S1: Render the mounted model chip for a pin whose switchedFrom reason is limit, reconnect, unavailable, and none.
S2: Build the Claude request body (anthropicPayload) with no maxTokens, and with maxTokens 4000.
expect: S1: "…because it reached its usage limit.", "…because it was signed out.", then "…because it was unavailable." twice.
S2: max_tokens 32000, then 4000; the request streams.
evidence: broker.js stores switched_from.reason; ModelChip rendered chip.switched for every reason. messages.js sent max_tokens 8192 while vendors/claude.js turns adaptive thinking on
fence: The chip reads the reason the broker stored; the Claude wire's default ceiling leaves room for thinking

tests: a tracy pin after a failover says where the chat came from
a plan pin after a failover names the plan and where the chat came from
the failover line says the reason the broker stored
a Claude request dsh gives no ceiling asks for 32000 output tokens
